# My Tesla Coils

 ![My Tesla Coils](/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/5620739994_1080ae890f_o-624x351.jpg)Written by Lucas Teske   
on 28 November 2016

So I added a Page ([http://www.teske.net.br/lucas/my-tesla-coils/](https://www.teske.net.br/lucas/my-tesla-coils/)) with my Tesla Coil Projects. It’s not by far all my videos (or my attempts) but shows some of the projects I did in the past. Checkout if you’re interested in Sparks and Music!
